newPlatforms.name: KVRX 91.7FM Digital-or-Physical Airplay Submission Route
newPlatforms.country: United States / Austin, Texas / University of Texas student radio
newPlatforms.feeAmount: No submission fee or mandatory payment is stated. Physical-media production, postage and customs costs would remain with the sender.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: KVRX officially accepts both digital and physical music submissions through its Music Department, but it explicitly excludes AI-assisted or AI-generated music. A human must confirm that the selected MarcsMusic release satisfies that policy, determine the currently accepted digital delivery format because the page does not specify attachment, download-link, codec, bitrate, release-window or metadata rules, confirm international eligibility, and manually send only to music@kvrx.org or use the published physical address. operations@kvrx.org is for questions and must not be treated as a duplicate submission mailbox.
newPlatforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-14 from KVRX's official Contact, homepage, Blog and programming pages. The Contact page explicitly states that all airplay submissions go to music@kvrx.org, that both physical and digital submissions are currently accepted, and that AI-assisted or generated music will not be considered. The first-party mailbox has valid syntax, explicit Music Department purpose and domain alignment. Current operation was confirmed through live now-playing functionality and official editorial posts dated through June 2, 2026; the station covers independent, electronic, experimental, hip-hop, world/reggae and other freeform music. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed. No email, file, link, physical package, identity claim or payment was sent.

newPlatforms.name: KDVS 90.3FM Physical-Only Music Department Airplay Submission Route
newPlatforms.country: United States / Davis, California / UC Davis student and community radio
newPlatforms.feeAmount: No editorial submission fee or mandatory payment is stated. Physical-media production, international postage, courier and customs costs would remain with the sender.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: KDVS currently authorizes physical submissions only. A human must choose an appropriate physical format, use the correct UPS/FedEx or USPS address, optionally route the package to the Electronic, Experimental, Hip Hop, Punk or Metal department, verify the address immediately before international shipping, and prepare accurate artist, release, contact, focus-track and clean-content information. musicdept@kdvs.org is a verified public Music Director business contact, but the official Contact page says all new music must be sent to the mailing address and therefore the mailbox must not be used for an unsolicited digital submission.
newPlatforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-14 from KDVS's official FAQ, Contact, homepage and Weekly Top 30 pages. The FAQ authorizes CDs, singles, records and tapes and publishes separate UPS/FedEx and USPS addresses; the Contact page identifies current Music Directors Avery Infantas and Mika Eloyan, publishes musicdept@kdvs.org and explicitly states physical submissions only. The mailbox has valid syntax, first-party domain alignment and a defined Music Department purpose, but it is classified as a business contact rather than a digital submission route. Current operation was confirmed through the live station site and official weekly charts dated through March 10, 2026, including self-released and electronic-adjacent releases. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed. No email, physical package, courier order, customs declaration or payment was sent.
